❀Notes√ Little smell is normal, putting it outside for few days, the smell will disappear.√ Please confirm the size according to our description instead of the product image.√ The size may be about 1 Inch measure error due to hand measure.√ Please allow little color difference due to different monitor or light env

items: Well made purses sets--soft lightweight high quality synthetic leather;tear-resistant light-colored polyester lining ;strong gold hardware;exquisite stitching.

items.label: ❀Hobo handbags--dimension
items.value: 12.8''x10.5''x5.5''(W*H*D),large capacity and multi-pocket design meet daily carrying,and clearly organized. lightweight:0.55kg/1.4lb;match widened shoulder strap (can relieve shoulder pressure)and long crossbody strap,can be converted between a shoulder bag or large crossbody purse.

items.label: ❀Crossbody bags--dimension
items.value: 7''x7.5''x0.7'',when you need to go out easily, this will be the most suitable match.

items.label: ❀Wallet clutch--dimension
items.value: 8.5''x4.5''x1'';RFID Blocking can protect personal information;easily holds 25 pieces of paper money,16 cards, ID card and an 6.7" iPhone and passport, pen, checkbook,etc.

items: Service Promise--IDESORT have our own design team and production plant, from the selection of materials to production are strictly controlled, while providing comprehensive after-sales service. If there is any problem with the product, please feel free to contact us to get a proper solution.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Allow any initial odor to dissipate naturally.
